versos.hebraico: וְנֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תַקְרִ֞יב קָרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְיָצַ֤ק עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְנָתַ֥ן עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.
controles.kjv: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
controles.livre: E quando alguma pessoa oferecer oferta de grãos de presente ao SENHOR, sua oferta será flor de farinha, sobre a qual lançará azeite, e porá sobre ela incenso:

versos.hebraico: וֶֽהֱבִיאָ֗הּ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹן֮ הַכֹּהֲנִים֒ וְקָמַ֨ץ מִשָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסָּלְתָּהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests; and he shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense; and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord:
controles.livre: E a trará aos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão; e disso tomará o sacerdote seu punho cheio de sua flor de farinha e de seu azeite, com todo seu incenso, e o fará arder sobre o altar: oferta acesa para memorial, de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy thing of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.
controles.kjv: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.
controles.livre: E a sobra da oferta será de Arão e de seus filhos: é coisa santíssima das ofertas que se queimam ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קָרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת חַלּ֤וֹת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס

controles.web: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
controles.kjv: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
controles.livre: E quando ofereceres oferta de presente cozida em forno, será de tortas de flor de farinha sem levedura, amassadas com azeite, e massas sem levedura untadas com azeite.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־מִנְחָ֥ה עַל־הַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן מַצָּ֥ה תִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: If your offering is a meal offering of the griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
controles.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
controles.livre: Mas se teu presente for oferta de alimentos de panelas, será de flor de farinha sem levedura, amassada com azeite,

versos.hebraico: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָהּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְיָצַקְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁ֑מֶן מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ס

controles.web: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
controles.livre: A qual partirás em peças, e expulsarás sobre ela azeite: é presente.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֥לֶת בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
controles.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
controles.livre: E se teu presente for oferta cozida em frigideira, ela será feita de flor de farinha com azeite.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִגִּישָׁ֖הּ אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to Yahweh: and it shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the Lord: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
controles.livre: E trarás ao SENHOR a oferta que se fará destas coisas, e a apresentarás ao sacerdote, o qual a chegará ao altar.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵרִ֨ים הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן־הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E tomará o sacerdote daquele presente, em memória do mesmo, e o fará arder sobre o altar; oferta acesa, de suave cheiro ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a thing most holy of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.
controles.kjv: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.
controles.livre: E o restante da oferta será de Arão e de seus filhos; é coisa santíssima das ofertas que se queimam ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י כָל־שְׂאֹר֙ וְכָל־דְּבַ֔שׁ לֹֽא־תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘No meal offering, which you shall offer to Yahweh, shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the Lord, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the Lord made by fire.
controles.livre: Nenhum presente que oferecerdes ao SENHOR, será com levedura: porque de nenhuma coisa levedada, nem de nenhum mel, se há de queimar oferta ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: קָרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לֹא־יַעֲל֖וּ לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹֽחַ׃

controles.web: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to Yahweh: but they shall not ascend for a pleasant aroma on the altar.
controles.kjv: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the Lord: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
controles.livre: Na oferta das primícias as oferecereis ao SENHOR: mas não subirão sobre o altar em cheiro suave.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־קָרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְךָ֮ בַּמֶּ֣לַח תִּמְלָח֒ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מֵעַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ל כָּל־קָרְבָּנְךָ֖ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃ס

controles.web: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt; neither shall you allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
controles.kjv: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
controles.livre: E temperarás toda oferta de teu presente com sal; e não farás que falte jamais de teu presente o sal da aliança de teu Deus: em toda oferta tua oferecerás sal.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה אָבִ֞יב קָל֤וּי בָּאֵשׁ֙ גֶּ֣רֶשׂ כַּרְמֶ֔ל תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits grain in the ear parched with fire, bruised grain of the fresh ear.
controles.kjv: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the Lord, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
controles.livre: E se ofereceres ao SENHOR presente de primícias, tostarás ao fogo as espigas verdes, e o grão esmigalhado oferecerás por oferta de tuas primícias.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֤ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָ֑ה מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃

controles.web: You shall put oil on it, and lay frankincense on it: it is a meal offering.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
controles.livre: E porás sobre ela azeite, e porás sobre ela incenso: é presente.

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָ֗הּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: The priest shall burn as its memorial, part of its bruised grain, and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E o sacerdote fará arder, em memória do presente, parte de seu grão esmigalhado, e de seu azeite com todo seu incenso; é oferta acesa ao SENHOR.
